"""Publish actual decode diagnostic and three native-batch pairs; retire duplicates."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import statistics
import traceback

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/diag-cpu-job-and-raw-bench-20261012')
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-12-decode-criticalpath-native-dequant-batch'
R = B / 'research-20261009'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('native_batch_publish_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L / 'venv/bin') + ':' + str(L / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin',
           HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')


def ident(p):
    return dict(path=str(p), sha256=m.sha(p), bytes=p.stat().st_size)


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-decode-and-native-batch-publication-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not F.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], source=ident(Path(__file__)), gpu_executed=False)

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, wall=180):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, W, wall=wall, cpu=240,
                             rss_cap=4 << 30, text_cap=4 << 20,
                             total_cap=32 << 20, file_cap=8 << 20)
        r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0
        return so.read_text().strip()

    files = []

    def write(name, value):
        p = F / name
        assert not p.exists()
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
        files.append(p)
        return p

    try:
        assert run('head-before', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '86f81cdc536cfedd27c1bdef0fb1d9b3b9631fb5'
        assert not run('status-before', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        assert run('branch', ['/usr/bin/git', 'branch', '--show-current']) == 'diag/cpu-job-and-raw-bench-20261012'
        assert run('origin', ['/usr/bin/git', 'remote', 'get-url', 'origin']) == 'git@github.com:yqYo1/Strata.git'
        assert all(line.startswith('file:/home/yayoi/.config/git/config') for line in run('identity', ['/usr/bin/git', 'config', '--show-origin', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$']).splitlines())
        paths = [B / 'main-decode-criticalpath-model-root-v1/xe-timed1-on/record.json',
                 B / 'main-prefill-native-batch-diagnostic-model-root-v1/xe-timed1-on/record.json']
        for i, arm in enumerate([0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1], 1):
            paths.append(B / f'main-prefill-native-batch-clean-model-root-v1/sample-{i}-batch-{arm}/xe-timed1-on/record.json')
        receipts = [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in paths]
        boot = Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()
        for receipt in receipts:
            assert receipt['passed'] and receipt['complete'] and not receipt['active']
            assert receipt['boot_id'] == boot and receipt['boot_unchanged'] and receipt['kernel_gate_passed']
            assert receipt['model_normal_close'] and not receipt['model_close']['forced']
            assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in receipt['commands'] + receipt['guard_commands'])
            assert receipt['validation']['token_logprob_sha256'] == receipts[0]['validation']['token_logprob_sha256']
        quiet = receipts[2:]
        ref_env = {k: v for k, v in quiet[0]['environment'].items() if k != 'STRATA_PREFILL_NATIVE_DEQUANT_BATCH'}
        for i, receipt in enumerate(quiet, 1):
            assert receipt['native_batch_clean_sample'] == i and receipt['performance_sample_eligible']
            assert receipt['argv'] == quiet[0]['argv'] and receipt['input']['sha256'] == quiet[0]['input']['sha256']
            assert receipt['binary'] == receipts[0]['binary']
            assert {k: v for k, v in receipt['environment'].items() if k != 'STRATA_PREFILL_NATIVE_DEQUANT_BATCH'} == ref_env
        arms = {}
        for arm in ['0', '1']:
            selected = [v for v in quiet if v['native_batch_arm'] == arm]
            arms[arm] = {phase: dict(individual_ms=[v['validation']['engine_' + phase + '_ms'] for v in selected],
                                     mean_ms=statistics.mean(v['validation']['engine_' + phase + '_ms'] for v in selected),
                                     stdev_ms=statistics.stdev(v['validation']['engine_' + phase + '_ms'] for v in selected))
                         for phase in ['prefill', 'decode']}
            arms[arm]['mean_individual_tps'] = {phase: statistics.mean((32768 if phase == 'prefill' else 16) * 1000 / v['validation']['engine_' + phase + '_ms'] for v in selected) for phase in ['prefill', 'decode']}
        pairs = []
        for a, b in [(quiet[0], quiet[1]), (quiet[3], quiet[2]), (quiet[4], quiet[5])]:
            assert a['native_batch_arm'] == '0' and b['native_batch_arm'] == '1'
            pairs.append(dict(off_sample=a['native_batch_clean_sample'], on_sample=b['native_batch_clean_sample'],
                              prefill_percent=100 * (b['validation']['engine_prefill_ms'] / a['validation']['engine_prefill_ms'] - 1),
                              decode_percent=100 * (b['validation']['engine_decode_ms'] / a['validation']['engine_decode_ms'] - 1)))
        percent = 100 * (arms['1']['prefill']['mean_ms'] / arms['0']['prefill']['mean_ms'] - 1)
        select = percent <= -3 and all(v['prefill_percent'] < 0 for v in pairs)
        groups = [{k: int(v) for k, v in re.findall(r'(\w+)=([0-9]+)', line)} for line in receipts[1]['native_group_lines']]
        assert len(groups) == 192 and all(v['gu_covered'] + v['gu_fallback_experts'] == v['gpu_order'] == v['down_covered'] + v['down_fallback_experts'] for v in groups)
        sums = {k: sum(v[k] for v in groups) for k in ['gu_admitted', 'down_admitted', 'gu_covered', 'down_covered', 'gu_fallback_experts', 'down_fallback_experts', 'gu_declined', 'down_declined']}
        grouped = sums['gu_admitted'] + sums['down_admitted'] + sums['gu_fallback_experts'] + sums['down_fallback_experts']
        individual = sums['gu_covered'] + sums['down_covered'] + sums['gu_fallback_experts'] + sums['down_fallback_experts']
        write('results.json', dict(source_revision='0691bcdf5af63a85b3b25650f367d3276db64035',
              scope='Arc B570 / Ryzen5600X, free LLVM7.1.1, nativeIQ3_S,32K+16,three matched independent-process pairs',
              configured_context=262144, actual_input_tokens=32768, full_context_qualified=False, restore_qualified=False,
              sequence=[0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1], individual_samples=[dict(sample=v['native_batch_clean_sample'], arm=v['native_batch_arm'], validation=v['validation'], host_wall_samples=v['host_wall_samples']) for v in quiet],
              arms=arms, pairs=pairs, prefill_mean_duration_percent=percent,
              native_batch_selected_for_this_recipe=select, engine_default_changed=False,
              decode_implementation_changed=False, decode_speed_gain_attributed_to_batch=False,
              whole_model_quality_qualified=False, all16_output_and_reported_LP5_equal=True,
              diagnostic_only_decode_line=receipts[0]['decode_timing_lines'][0],
              diagnostic_native_group_sums=sums, dequant_commands=grouped, equivalent_individual_commands=individual,
              native_diagnostic_validation_overhead=True,
              limits=['One decode diagnostic: overlapping/nested spans, no exclusive GPU kernel/CPU worker-cycle claim.', 'The three matched pairs support this hardware/32K recipe only; no full256K/RESTORE/full-logit/quality/peak-capacity claim.', 'Prefill batch flag does not select decode math; any decode time variation is not attributed to this pref-only change.']))
        write('selected-tuning.json', dict(binary=quiet[0]['binary'], source_revision='0691bcdf5af63a85b3b25650f367d3276db64035',
              argv=quiet[0]['argv'], environment=dict(ref_env, STRATA_PREFILL_NATIVE_DEQUANT_BATCH='1' if select else '0'),
              selected_native_batch=select, scope='Qualified32K/8192/G16 recipe for next tuning; retain262144 capacity, globaldefault unchanged',
              next_checks=['Same recipe64K; physical262144 boundary and RESTORE remain pending.', 'Direct groupedGEMM device-event service and safe2D H2D cohort copies; no blind clock/profile enable.']))
        deletion = []
        for i, (p, receipt) in enumerate(zip(paths, receipts)):
            archive = F / f'receipts/sample-{i:02d}.json'
            archive.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            archive.write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
            assert m.sha(archive) == m.sha(p)
            files.append(archive)
            evidence = []
            for c in receipt['commands'] + receipt['guard_commands']:
                for name, pin in c['logs'].items():
                    raw = p.parent / 'commands' / name
                    assert m.sha(raw) == pin['sha256'] and raw.stat().st_size == pin['bytes']
                    evidence.append(dict(original=ident(raw), text=raw.read_text()))
            replacement = write(f'evidence/sample-{i:02d}.json', dict(original_receipt=ident(p), evidence=evidence))
            for item in evidence:
                deletion.append(dict(original=item['original'], replacement=str(replacement.relative_to(W)),
                                     reason='Exact compact evidence and original status committed; closed successful duplicate stdout/stderr.'))
        for name in ['main-decode-criticalpath-model-v1.py', 'main-decode-criticalpath-controller-review-v1.json',
                     'main-prefill-native-batch-diagnostic-model-v1.py', 'main-prefill-native-batch-diagnostic-controller-review-v1.json',
                     'main-prefill-native-batch-clean-model-v1.py', 'main-prefill-native-batch-clean-model-v2.py',
                     'main-prefill-native-batch-clean-controller-review-v1.json', 'main-decode-and-native-batch-publication-v1.py']:
            p = B / name
            write('controllers/' + name + '.json', dict(original=ident(p), content=p.read_text()))
        reports = []
        for n in range(269, 275):
            found = list(R.glob('*round' + str(n) + '-v1.txt'))
            assert len(found) == 1
            p = found[0]
            write('research/' + p.name + '.json', dict(original=ident(p), content=p.read_text(), model='gpt-6-luna', main_full_review=True, source_only=True))
            reports.append(ident(p))
        folder = 'implementation-native-grouped-gemm-event-bench-source-v3'
        report = R / (folder + '.txt')
        assert m.sha(report) == '8c54bca093310ae0455e307eacc2257cc2449d4c4637e06ae7d7950d9b5f6b17'
        write('research/' + report.name + '.json', dict(original=ident(report), content=report.read_text(), model='gpt-6.1-sol', main_full_report_review=True, source_contract_and_delta_reviewed=True, status='SourceOnlyUnverified; fullsource/build/lint/runtime qualification pending'))
        reports.append(ident(report))
        packet = B / folder
        manifest = json.loads((packet / 'manifest.json').read_text())
        assert manifest['status'] == 'SOURCE_ONLY_UNVERIFIED'
        for name in ['manifest.json', 'changes.patch', 'SOURCE_CONTRACT.txt', 'MAIN_TEST_PLAN.txt', 'file-hashes.json']:
            source = packet / name
            write('source-packets/' + name + '.json', dict(original=ident(source), content=source.read_text(), status='SourceOnlyUnverified'))
        for name, values in manifest['files'].items():
            before = packet / 'before' / name
            after = packet / 'after' / name
            assert m.sha(before) == values['before_sha256'] and m.sha(after) == values['after_sha256']
        # The diagnostic common helper and production prefix remain unchanged across v2/v3.
        src_before = (packet / 'before/src/kernels/xe/xmx_gemm.cpp').read_text()
        src_after = (packet / 'after/src/kernels/xe/xmx_gemm.cpp').read_text()
        prefix_before = src_before[:src_before.index('GroupedGemmSubmission grouped_gemm_diagnostic(')]
        prefix_after = src_after[:src_after.index('GroupedBoundsValidation validate_grouped_device_bounds(')]
        assert prefix_before == prefix_after
        previous = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-12-avx2-expert-roofline-and-paired-gu/report-registry-v162.json'
        assert json.loads(previous.read_text())['research_completed'] == 775
        write('report-registry-v163.json', dict(research_completed=782, prior=ident(previous), new_reports=reports,
              corrections=['R270 separatelyauthorized profiling/longcontext is not required: user already authorized tuning; no new approval inferred.',
                           'R270 ordinary pool multi/overlap summaries are not emitted by this persistent serve route; actual diagnostic arrays are empty. Use request deltas if those phases are needed.',
                           'R271 compares SYCL9.0.0 with packaged7.1.1: both deployed504366f4b8 and newerroot declare SYCL9.0.0 ABI; distribution and ABI are distinct. Deployed CommandGraph design/usage hashes match cited files; graph extension file differs. No runtime host-task performance conclusion.',
                           'R272 calls closed decode wall data clean; STRATA_DECODE_TIMING is diagnostic-only and performance_eligibleFalse. No stage-clock/time conversion asserted.',
                           'R274 v2 remains SourceOnly; valid nonzero positive timestamps/device bounds/greaterM are prerequisites for future direct-event qualification.']))
        md = F / 'README.md'
        text = ['<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->', '<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->', '',
                '# Decodeの時間内訳とnative逆量子化バッチ', '',
                'Arc B57010GiB / Ryzen5600X、free LLVM7.1.1、0691bcdf、32K入力・16出力です。',
                'context容量262144、チャンク8192、G16、キャッシュ144slots、CPU5workersを固定しました。', '',
                '既存のdecode計測は124.09ms/tokenでした。GPU受け渡し地点までの待ち50.27ms、',
                'レイヤーのホスト処理55.16ms（この中のCPU処理区間50.64ms）、verify全体121.44msです。',
                'これらは包含関係を持つホスト時間で、GPUカーネル時間やCPU実行サイクルそのものではありません。',
                'commit/emit2.65ms、CPU9.45experts/layer、VRAM0.55hits/layerでした。', '',
                '逆量子化バッチは192個のレイヤー・チャンク記録で全て受理され、',
                f'カーネル発行は個別経路相当{individual:,}回から{grouped:,}回に減りました。',
                'H2Dは97728回・199990579200bytesのままです。これはリクエストのコピー範囲で、物理DMA計測ではありません。', '',
                '検証レイヤーと計測ログを外し、OFF/ON/ON/OFF/OFF/ONの独立プロセスで測定しました。',
                'すべて正常QUIT、整数演算テスト・新規GPU障害確認を通り、16出力IDと報告LP5が一致しました。', '',
                '| 設定 | prefill各回 ms | prefill平均 t/s | decode各回 ms | decode平均 t/s |',
                '| --- | --- | ---: | --- | ---: |']
        for arm in ['0', '1']:
            a = arms[arm]
            pp = ', '.join(f'{x:.1f}' for x in a['prefill']['individual_ms'])
            dd = ', '.join(f'{x:.1f}' for x in a['decode']['individual_ms'])
            text.append(f"| {'OFF' if arm == '0' else 'ON'} | {pp} | {a['mean_individual_tps']['prefill']:.2f} | {dd} | {a['mean_individual_tps']['decode']:.2f} |")
        text += ['', f'prefillの平均時間差は{percent:.2f}%です。',
                 'この32K設定ではprefillバッチを次のチューニング設定に採用します。' if select else '安定した改善の条件を満たさず、次の設定もOFFを維持します。',
                 'decodeの計算経路は変更しておらず、decodeの時間差をこの変更の効果とは扱いません。',
                 'エンジン全体の既定値も変更していません。選択したコマンド・環境はselected-tuning.jsonに保存しました。', '',
                 '1000/70t/sは未達です。64K、256K全量、RESTORE、全logits・タスク品質は未検証です。',
                 '次は実際のgrouped GEMMイベント時間と、スロット寿命を守る転送のまとめ方を検証します。',
                 '個別値、元のレシート、バイナリ・ライブラリhash、コマンド・明示環境、正常終了と障害確認を保存しています。', '']
        md.write_text('\n'.join(text))
        files.append(md)
        write('retention-manifest.json', dict(phase='prepared', original_statuses_preserved=True, deletions=deletion,
              files=len(deletion), logical_bytes=sum(v['original']['bytes'] for v in deletion),
              reason='Retire only after exact evidence commit/push; no fixtures, model, source, services or GPU state touched.'))
        setup = json.loads((B / 'latest-update-main-finalization-host-root-v8/record.json').read_text())
        assert setup['passed'] and not setup['active']
        ENV.update(GEM_PATH=setup['environment']['GEM_PATH'], RUBYLIB=setup['environment']['RUBYLIB'])
        run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *map(str, files)], wall=300)
        run('gitleaks', [str(L / 'bin/gitleaks'), 'dir', str(F), '--no-banner', '--redact'])
        run('stage', ['/usr/bin/git', 'add', '--', str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('diff-check', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check'])
        run('commit', ['/usr/bin/git', 'commit', '-m', 'perf(prefill): qualify native dequant batching and record decode costs'])
        r['evidence_revision'] = run('evidence-head', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push-evidence', ['/usr/bin/git', 'push', 'origin', 'HEAD'])
        for item in deletion:
            p = Path(item['original']['path'])
            assert ident(p) == item['original']
            p.unlink()
        completed = write('retention-completed.json', dict(evidence_revision=r['evidence_revision'],
              phase='completed', original_statuses_preserved=True, deleted=deletion,
              files=len(deletion), logical_bytes=sum(v['original']['bytes'] for v in deletion)))
        run('retention-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', str(completed)], wall=180)
        run('retention-stage', ['/usr/bin/git', 'add', '--', str(completed.relative_to(W))])
        run('retention-commit', ['/usr/bin/git', 'commit', '-m', 'chore(bench): retire closed native batch measurement logs'])
        r['revision'] = run('head-after', ['/usr/bin/git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push-retention', ['/usr/bin/git', 'push', 'origin', 'HEAD'])
        assert not run('status-after', ['/usr/bin/git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(complete=True, arms=arms, pairs=pairs, selected_native_batch=select)
    except BaseException as error:
        r.update(error=repr(error), traceback=traceback.format_exc())
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'revision', 'selected_native_batch')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
